title: A Bring-Up Checklist for a Real Board: Ten Cheap Checks Before the First Drive, Run Against a Fake of the Board

questions.question: Why is the bring-up written at a lower level than the Drive?
options: Its job is to find out whether the numbers the higher level will trust are right
questions.explanation: You cannot check a foundation from above it.

questions.question: The healthy fake passed how many of the checks?
questions.explanation: A board with nothing wrong passes all.

questions.question: A tick count 15 percent off read as how many ticks a metre?
Why does a reversed left motor fail three checks?
options: The wheel counts down for a left command and cancels the other in the scale: the checks behind the cause fail with it
questions.explanation: A consequence is not a second fault.

questions.question: Why should a failed check say what to do?
options: A line that can be acted on saves the search that a bare failure starts
questions.explanation: Advice is part of the check.

questions.question: Why is the direction check made before the scale check?
options: A reversed motor makes the scale meaningless
questions.explanation: Order the checks by what depends on what.
